extension.news: [B]3.20.4[/B] - Updated video lyrics - video lyrics can now be toggled without exiting the player - Added skin integration of Skin Info image viewer - Added inherited TV show fanart indicator to Skin Info manage artwork dialog - Added Skin Info Next Up (Favorites) widget - Prevent switching to fullscreen when playing tracks from music info dialog - Hide TMDbHelper widgets in picker dialog if TMDbHelper is disabled - Fixed use of invalid TMDbHelper data in PVR radio views - Fixed local collections in video info dialog - Fixed and simplified logic for fallback images - Fixed initial focus of PVR search dialog - Fixed position of submenu popup for non netflix vertical multi widgets - Fixed slide animation of vertical submenus - Fixed visibility of widget navigation arrows - Fixed album count in multiwidgets header label - Fixed layout of PVR icon and card view mode - Fixed height of PVR side OSD plot box - Fixed aspect ratio of video OSD poster - Fixed position of video OSD submenus - Fixed video OSD disc animation - Fixed layout of video side OSD for PVR - Fixed slide animation of video side OSD - Fixed video side OSD player status info (removed fade labels) - Fixed temperature clock font

extension.description: Arctic: Zephyr - Martian basiert auf dem original Arctic: Zephyr Skin von jurialmunkey und dessen Erweiterungen durch beatmasterRS. Es ist ein minimalistisches, klares und simples Interface für deine Medien mit dem gewissen Etwas.

Arctic: Zephyr - Martian is based on the original Arctic: Zephyr skin, created by jurialmunkey and it's extension by beatmasterRS. Arctic focuses on being simple, clean and minimalistic with a light spin.
